data.title: Verdict: AcmeDB Is on Trial!
data.subject: AcmeDB
data.take: the boring database that actually SHIPS, no vaporware circus act
data.summary: AcmeDB does ONE thing, durable key-value storage, and does it without an operator PhD, no consensus wizardry, no sharding astrology, just a WAL, a manifest, and docs that actually answer the damn question you asked!

receipts.evidence: vendor benchmark on a laptop, not replicated
the docs list snapshots as 'coming soon'

data.bottom_line: Ship it behind a cache, hell yes! Crown jewels? Keep that precious shit OUT of it!
caveats: We did not run our own benchmark. The latency number is theirs, not ours.
Checked against the docs on the date above. Roadmaps move.

quotes.text: Cross-region replication is on the roadmap.
quotes.used_for: the single-region blocker, aka you're STUCK in one damn region

quotes.text: p99 read latency under 2ms on a laptop.
quotes.used_for: the latency claim, read as a CEILING, not a promise

footnotes.benchmark: Benchmark numbers are vendor-reported; treat them as the ceiling, not the floor.
footnotes.backup-gap: Backup gap confirmed against the docs page on demo-freeze day.
